def map_country(val):
    if pd.isna(val) or not str(val).strip():
        return "UNKNOWN"
    s = str(val).strip().lower()
    mapping = {
        "de": "DE",
        "germany": "DE",
        "deutschland": "DE",
        "ger": "DE",
        "deutshcland": "DE",
        "at": "AT",
        "austria": "AT",
        "österreich": "AT",
        "oesterreich": "AT",

        "ch": "CH",
        "switzerland": "CH",

        "suisse": "CH",
        "che": "CH",
        "fr": "FR",
        "france": "FR",
        "frankreich": "FR",
        "fra": "FR",
        "gb": "GB",
        "uk": "GB",
        "united kingdom": "GB",
        "great britain": "GB",
        "gbr": "GB",
        "england": "GB",
        "us": "US",
        "usa": "US",
        "united states": "US",
        "united states of america": "US",
        "it": "IT",
        "italy": "IT",
        "italien": "IT",
        "ita": "IT",
        "es": "ES",

        "spanien": "ES",
        "esp": "ES",
        "nl": "NL",
        "netherlands": "NL",
        "niederlande": "NL",
        "nld": "NL",
    }
    if s in mapping:
        return mapping[s]
    if "deut" in s or "germ" in s:
        return "DE"
    if "öster" in s or "oester" in s or "austr" in s:
        return "AT"
    if "schweiz" in s or "switz" in s or "suiss" in s:
        return "CH"
    if "frank" in s or "franc" in s:
        return "FR"
    if "span" in s or "spai" in s:
        return "ES"
    if "ital" in s:
        return "IT"
    if "nieder" in s or "nether" in s:
        return "NL"
    if "kingd" in s or "brit" in s or "engl" in s:
        return "GB"
    if "stat" in s or "americ" in s:
        return "US"
    if len(s) == 2 and s.isalpha():
        return s.upper()
    return "UNKNOWN"

        order_count=("order_id", "count"),
    )
    .sort_values(by="total_revenue_eur", ascending=False)
